title: Singapore dollar to Malaysian ringgit, daily since 1999
description: Ringgit per Singapore dollar each working day since 1999, from our cross of the ECB's euro reference rates, with Bank Negara Malaysia's noon interbank middle rate beside it from 2010.
question: What is the Singapore dollar worth in ringgit, on any working day since 1999?

fields.meaning: The day the rate is for.

fields.meaning: Our cross of the ECB's euro reference rates: ringgit per euro divided by S$ per euro.

fields.name: myr_per_sgd_bnm_noon_middle
fields.meaning: Bank Negara Malaysia's noon interbank middle rate for the Singapore dollar; from January 2010.
